method: For every saved drawn route with a truthy cross flag, verify the saved raw router points appear verbatim inside its drawn path with two added points per access endpoint; remove the cross flag and substitute only those raw points; reuse frozen measure and retain only new edge-through-node issues. No scores, labels, geometry, routes, trial status, or policy results are rewritten.
scope: Snapshot census of every saved data/geometry artifact assigned to the requested split by task definitions, including hard-invalid outputs and noncanonical artifacts. No opposite-split artifact is opened. Layout checkpoints and route caches lack complete drawn-route evidence and are outside this census.
geometryScope: Native visible node rectangles equal doc.layout.nodes via production makeGeometry/visibleRects. Collapsed group frames use saved production routeInput groups; any new collapsed-group intersections are kept separately from the requested native-node findings.

sourceEvidence.fact: drawRoutes extends both endpoints but cross stores destination extension preferentially; raw router points omit both intentional extensions.

limitations: These are supplementary unscored findings, not a revised frozen metric or reranked result table.
If crossRoutes is zero, observed corpus coverage of this path is absent; analytical checks demonstrate the mechanism but do not substitute for product examples.
The census is a timestamped filesystem snapshot; rerun after later development or heldout artifacts finish.
Full intentional access extensions are excluded, not accepted as arbitrary body paths through other cells.
Group-title, label, detour, side-selection, and rounded appearance differences are deliberately not rescored.
